reviews.title: Nzxt h7 high flow
reviews.comment: Great case and very easy to work in with hiding wires
reviews.author: auggren

reviews.title: Love this case
reviews.comment: This case is absolutely amazing! Plenty of room along with plenty of cut out slots for wiring to run through. Speaking of wiring the case has built in Velcro holders in the back for easier wire management. 2 slots in the back for HDD. Overall a great case.
reviews.author: JoshuaZ

reviews.title: Great Case/Great Value
reviews.comment: Great case.  Perfect for AIO builds.  I've been wanting a case with NZXT's design language, but with decent airflow, for the better part of a decade now. Nobody does elegant minimalism like NZXT. This case is pretty much the perfect ATX case for me, and I'm glad they keep making them like this.
reviews.author: MichaelF

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.comment: Was just the right size for my setup! Id recommend to anyone!
reviews.author: Danny

reviews.title: Great Case!
reviews.comment: This Case is absolutely Amazing! I had some difficulties when putting my parts in, however I quickly realized it was User error (aka my fault haha) if you need a great case that can fit any GPU this is it!
reviews.author: ChrisS
